issues.title: Avatar hidden behind content box in intro/memory modes
issues.description: In intro and memory section modes, the avatar appears behind the content box instead of in front. The content box needs lower z-index or avatar needs higher z-index for these modes.
issues.solution: Repositioned mode-center layout: avatar now on right side (right: 5%, height: 85%, z-index: 15), content-wrapper on left side (z-index: 10, padding-left: 5%, max-width: 65%). This gives the avatar clear visibility alongside content rather than hidden behind it.

issues.title: Text content not displaying when sharing/loading videos
issues.description: When accessing the player via shared URL, text content doesn't appear in content-box. May be race condition with displayItems population or typewriter initialization.
issues.solution: Root cause: segment-item and flashcard had very low default opacity (0.3-0.4) making them nearly invisible on dark background. Fixed by: 1) Increased base opacity to 0.7-0.75, 2) Added logic to mark first segment/flashcard as active on load for full visibility.

issues.title: Player initial load is very slow
issues.description: Player takes too long to load initially. Likely caused by preloading all audio files upfront instead of on-demand.
issues.solution: Implemented lazy video detection: 1) Only detect videos for current slide before showing UI, 2) Added detectVideosForSlide() with caching, 3) Background detection for remaining slides via detectRemainingVideosInBackground(), 4) Made loadSlide async to support on-demand detection.

issues.title: Avatar too small in video-primary mode and blank video at start
issues.description: When video plays, avatar is super tiny. Also blank video box appears before content loads. Avatar should be larger and content should appear instantly.
issues.solution: 1) Increased mode-content-video avatar size to 55% height and 35% max-width, 2) Added video-box opacity:0 by default with .video-ready class for opacity:1, 3) Added oncanplay event to add video-ready class when video is ready to play.

issues.title: LaTeX symbols in narration text cause TTS to read raw LaTeX
issues.description: Mathematical symbols like $h$ are passed to TTS as-is, so narration says 'dollar h dollar' instead of 'h'. Need to strip/convert LaTeX before sending to TTS.
issues.solution: Created core/latex_to_speech.py that converts LaTeX to speakable text (fractions, powers, Greek letters, operators). Integrated into tts/generate_audio.py to process narration before Narakeet API call.

issues.title: Add dev mode position/size stats overlay for layout debugging
issues.description: When toggling dev mode, display real-time position and size statistics for content wrapper and avatar so user can provide feedback on layout adjustments.
issues.solution: Added #dev-stats-overlay in player HTML showing layout mode, avatar position/size/aspect, content position/size, video box dimensions. Stats update every 500ms when visible. Toggle with D key or Dev button.

issues.title: Manim video sometimes cuts off at bottom
issues.description: Manim-rendered videos sometimes have content that extends below the visible area. Need dynamic vertical centering or adjustment based on video content.
issues.prior_attempt: Added object-fit: contain but video-box container height was still constrained by max-height: 60vh.
issues.solution: Changed video-box to height: fit-content and overflow: visible, video element to height: auto with max-height: 80vh. This allows videos to display at natural aspect ratio while preventing viewport overflow.

issues.title: Manim video cutoff - video-box height constraint too small
issues.description: Video-box had max-height: 60vh which was too small for taller Manim animations. Content at bottom of video was clipped.
issues.solution: Changed #stage from fixed height: 720px to min-height: 720px, height: auto, max-height: 90vh. This allows stage to expand for taller videos. Combined with max-height: 90vh on .mode-content-video #video-box for contained presentation.

issues.title: Text not displayed in content-video mode
issues.description: In mode-content-video, the content-box was hidden by default (max-width: 0, opacity: 0). Text only appeared when .text-visible class was manually added.
issues.solution: Modified player.js loadSlide() to synchronously detect rendered content (segments-list children, flashcards, quiz-containers) after DOM population. Adds .text-visible class when content exists, removes when empty. No setTimeout - runs immediately after content insertion.

issues.title: Avatar loses resolution/aspect ratio when resized
issues.description: When avatar is resized or repositioned, it appears stretched or loses quality. Aspect ratio should be maintained.
issues.solution: Added image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast and image-rendering: crisp-edges to #avatar-canvas for better quality during canvas rendering.

issues.title: v1.2 Architecture Upgrade - 3-Pass LLM Pipeline
issues.description: Upgrade from 2-LLM architecture to 3-pass architecture with role-pure separation of concerns. Pass 0: Chunker (Gemini Flash), Pass 1: Director (Gemini Pro) for pedagogy only, Pass 2: Specialized renderers (Claude Sonnet for Manim/Remotion, Gemini Pro for Video).
issues.solution: Created: 1) core/llm_client_v12.py with 3-pass pipeline functions, 2) core/analytics.py for per-phase cost/time tracking, 3) core/pipeline_v12.py for production use, 4) 10 new prompt files in core/prompts/, 5) Backed up v1.1 to pipeline_v11.py and prompts/v1.1_backup/. Added validation to strip renderer fields from Director output and verify renderer output exists after Pass 2.

Director generating 109-120 word narrations instead of 150+

issues.title: Manim renderer expects v1.1 visual_beats but v1.2 provides section-level manim_scene_spec
issues.description: v1.2 Director generates manim_scene_spec at section level (not per visual_beat). The Manim runner tries to iterate through visual_beats calling compile_manim_plan() on each, which fails because v1.2 visual_beats only have {time, description} fields, not the structured manim_scene_spec required by Visual Compiler.
issues.root_cause: Architecture mismatch: v1.2 uses 3-pass architecture where Manim Renderer LLM generates the full manim_scene_spec for the whole section, but manim_runner.py's multi-beat path calls compile_manim_plan() on each beat expecting v1.1 structure.
fix: 1. renderer_executor.py: Store v1.2 manim_scene_spec under 'v12_manim_scene_spec' key
2. manim_runner.py: Added _render_v12_manim_spec() function to detect v12 spec BEFORE multi-beat iteration
3. Uses translate_spec_to_manim_code() directly to render single video for entire section
files_changed: core/renderer_executor.py: Changed key from compiled_manim_plan to v12_manim_scene_spec
render/manim/manim_runner.py: Added _render_v12_manim_spec() function, updated render_manim_video() to check for v12 spec first

issues.title: Manim CLI crashes on labels with latex property
issues.description: Manim render fails for content_01 and content_02 sections while example_01 succeeds. Root cause: LLM generates labels with 'latex' property (e.g., '\text{coefficient of }x^2') but translate_spec_to_manim_code() label handler only checks for 'text' property, falling back to object ID and using Text() instead of MathTex().
symptoms: Manim CLI crashes with truncated stacktrace
Return code: 1 from manim render command
example_01 succeeds but content_01 and content_02 fail
issues.root_cause: Label handler in visual_compiler.py only checked props.get('text'), not props.get('latex'). When LLM uses latex for mathematical labels, the code generated invalid Text() calls instead of MathTex().
issues.fix: Updated label handler in translate_spec_to_manim_code() to: 1) Check for latex property first, 2) Use MathTex() with scale when latex is provided, 3) Fall back to Text() only for plain text labels.

issues.title: Manim crashes due to \text{} in MathTex being converted to Tex
issues.description: _sanitize_manim_code() was converting MathTex to Tex when \text{} was present, but this caused 'Missing $ inserted' LaTeX errors because Tex uses non-math mode where \text{} and superscripts don't work together.
issues.error: LaTeX compilation error: Missing $ inserted. Context: \begin{center} a: \text{coefficient of }x^2 \end{center}
issues.fix: Changed _sanitize_manim_code() to replace \text{} with \textrm{} instead of converting MathTex to Tex. \textrm{} works properly in math mode.

issues.title: Graph objects fail when axes not defined in spec
issues.description: LLM generates graph objects that reference 'axes' variable but doesn't include an axes object in the spec. This causes NameError: name 'axes' is not defined.
issues.fix: Added auto-axes creation in translate_spec_to_manim_code(): Pre-scans objects for graph/area_under_graph types, checks if referenced axes are declared, and auto-creates missing axes with default x_range=[-5,5,1], y_range=[-3,3,1]. Logs warning when fallback axes are generated.

issues.title: Legacy endpoints use shared ASSETS_DIR instead of job folders
issues.description: /process_pdf and /process_markdown endpoints bypass job isolation by writing directly to player/assets/ instead of creating job-specific folders. This causes assets to overwrite each other between jobs.
issues.fix: Updated both endpoints to create job folders using job_manager.create_job() and setup_job_folder(), matching the /submit endpoint pattern.

issues.title: Player.js AVATAR_URL hardcoded to shared assets path

issues.fix: Changed AVATAR_URL to use BASE_PATH + 'avatar_placeholder.mp4' for job-relative resolution.

issues.title: File-based job storage not scalable for production
issues.description: Current architecture uses single in-process JobManager with file-based storage. Cannot handle 50,000+ concurrent jobs due to: serialized execution, no cleanup mechanism, inode exhaustion risk, slow I/O under load.
issues.recommended_solution: Externalize job metadata to PostgreSQL, use Redis/SQS job queue with worker processes, move media to S3 + CDN, make API stateless.

issues.title: All video sections overwrite same file (topic_1.mp4)

All Manim sections logged as topic_1

issues.resolution_note: Fixed by renderer_executor.execute_renderer using section_id for video filenames

issues.solution: Updated manim_renderer_system_v1.2.txt and manim_renderer_user_v1.2.txt with TIMING RULES section requiring first action be visual element. Re-rendered job 4f3411e9 - all 3 sections now start with show_equation (duration 1-2s).

issues.title: Manim animation has idle period at end with no visual activity
issues.description: Animation ends with static visuals while narration continues. The 4-6 seconds at the end have no visual motion to accompany the closing recap narration.
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt to include closing animation (e.g., fade out, summary highlight, or recap motion) during final seconds.
issues.solution: Added CLOSING ANIMATION REQUIRED rule to prompts. Re-rendered sections now end with highlight actions on key elements (main_equation, quadratic_formula, final_box).

issues.title: Manim layout overcrowding - equations and labels overlap
issues.description: In topic_example_01.mp4 (screenshot 3), multiple equations and steps are rendered too close together, making the screen cluttered and hard to read. Text overlaps and spacing is insufficient.
issues.good_example: topic_content_01.mp4 (screenshot 2) shows clean layout with clear spacing between equation, labels, and arrows
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt with layout/spacing guidelines: minimum 1.0 unit vertical spacing between elements, use VGroup for organizing related elements, avoid placing more than 3-4 equation lines on screen simultaneously.
issues.solution: Added LAYOUT RULES section with vertical spacing requirements (1.5 units), screen regions, and max 4 elements visible. example_01 now uses y-positions: 2.5, 1.5, 0, -1.5, -2.5 with proper 1.0-1.5 unit gaps.

issues.title: Manim content_02 Discriminant label overlaps formula
issues.description: In topic_content_02.mp4 (screenshot 1), the 'Discriminant' label is positioned inside the square root sign area, overlapping with the formula. Label should be positioned above or beside the formula with an arrow.
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt to specify label positioning rules: labels should not overlap with formulas, use arrows to point from labels to formula parts.
issues.solution: Added LABEL POSITIONING rules requiring 0.8+ unit separation. Re-rendered content_02 has discriminant_label at y=1 (above formula elements at y=0.5 and below).

issues.title: Avatar missing (null) in presentation.json
issues.description: Job b5042fd3 has avatar: null in presentation.json. Director LLM did not set avatar metadata, causing avatar not to display.

issues.solution: Created v1.3 Director prompts with MANDATORY SECTION ORDER and hard failure rule. Added validate_v13_structure() to check for intro, summary, memory, recap.

issues.title: Intro text not displayed properly
issues.description: Intro section visual_beats contain descriptive text instead of display text. Player cannot render proper intro overlays.
issues.root_cause: v1.2 prompts allowed LLM to output scene descriptions instead of structured display_directives.

issues.solution: Created v1.3 with DISPLAY DIRECTION section requiring display_directives on every segment. Added validate_v13_section_rules() to check for missing directives.

issues.title: Recap and Memory sections fail hard-fail validation despite retry mechanism
issues.description: Dry runs with both Gemini 2.5 Pro and Claude 3.5 Sonnet produce recap sections with 0 scenes (need 5) and memory sections with 0 flashcards (need 5). Schema validation passes but semantic validation fails. Director retry logic exists but isn't catching these structural issues at schema level.
validation_failures: recap_scene_count_wrong: Recap section has 0 scenes, must be exactly 5
recap_narration_below_minimum: Recap total narration is 0 words, minimum is 300
memory_flashcard_count_wrong: Memory section has 0 flashcards, must be exactly 5
issues.root_cause: Schema only validates general structure (visual_beats array), not section-type-specific content like recap scenes or memory flashcards. Additionally, hard_fail_validator was looking for legacy fields (recap_scenes, flashcards) instead of v1.3 structure (visual_beats).

details: Update JSON schema to require exactly 5 recap scenes in visual_beats when section_type=recap
Update JSON schema to require exactly 5 flashcards in visual_beats when section_type=memory
Keep semantic retry logic for word-count and visualization rules
Add canonical JSON examples for memory and recap sections in Director system prompt
approved_solution.rationale: Schema-level enforcement triggers retry mechanism before reaching semantic validator. Prompt examples reduce retry frequency by showing LLM exact expected format.

solution: 1. Updated schemas/presentation_v1.3.schema.json with section-type-specific definitions (memory_section, recap_section, generic_section) using oneOf pattern. Memory and recap sections now require exactly 5 visual_beats.
2. Added canonical JSON examples for memory (5 flashcards) and recap (5 scenes with 60-100 word narration each) sections to core/prompts/director_system_v1.3.txt
3. Fixed core/hard_fail_validator.py to read from visual_beats instead of legacy recap_scenes/flashcards fields for v1.3 validation
4. Fixed recap narration word count to read from narration.segments instead of legacy scene-based structure

issues.title: display_directives at section-level array instead of per-segment - Player cannot read them

core/prompts/director_retry_system_v1.3.txt - Retry prompt may perpetuate wrong structure
downstream_impact: player/player.js LayerController - Cannot find display_directives, defaults to hide all
Text/visual mutual exclusion enforcement not triggered
solution: 1. Updated director_system_v1.3.txt canonical JSON to embed display_directives inside each narration segment with flat string enums
2. Updated schemas/presentation_v1.3.schema.json to require display_directives on narration_segment with enum validation
3. Updated tier1_structural.py to validate per-segment display_directives with flat string format and mutual exclusion check
4. Updated director_retry_system_v1.3.txt with explicit fix instructions for display_directives structure

issues.title: Player reads slide.recap_scenes but v1.3 uses slide.visual_beats for recap
issues.description: Recap section navigation checks slide.recap_scenes, but v1.3 stores scene data in slide.visual_beats[]. Result: Recap scene navigation broken.

issues.title: v1.3 schema missing visual_content channel - narration text displayed instead of document content
issues.description: The v1.3 schema lacked a dedicated visual_content field at the narration segment level. Narration text (audio script) was being displayed on screen instead of structured display content (bullet points, formulas, labels) extracted from the source document.
issues.root_cause: Schema separation issue - narration.segments[].text is meant for TTS audio only, but player had nowhere else to get displayable content from. The visual_content channel was never added to the schema.
symptoms: Player displays narration transcript on screen
Bullet points from source document not visible
Text layer shows voiceover script instead of structured content
Progressive reveal of bullets not possible

solution.schema_changes: Added visual_content object to narration_segment in presentation_v1.3.schema.json with bullet_points[] (level, text), formula, labels[]
solution.docs_changes: Updated llm_output_requirements_v1.3.json with two-channel separation documentation
prompt_changes: Added TWO-CHANNEL SEPARATION and VISUAL_CONTENT RULES sections to director_system_v1.3.txt
Updated canonical JSON examples in director_system_v1.3.txt with visual_content field
Updated director_retry_system_v1.3.txt with visual_content repair instructions
player_changes: Added aggregation of visual_content from all segments in slide mapping
Added bullet-level-1 and bullet-level-2 CSS classes for hierarchy styling
Updated segment rendering to detect {level, text} objects and apply appropriate classes
Added whitelist-based legacy version guard: ['', 'v1.0', 'v1.1', 'v1.2'] get narration fallback, v1.3+ enforces visual_content
Added visible error placeholder for v1.3+ violations: '[Missing display content - visual_content required]'
validator_changes: Added tier1 validation: text_layer=show segments require visual_content for content/example/intro/summary sections

backward_compatibility.v13_behavior: Enforces visual_content, shows error placeholder if missing

two_channel_design.narration_channel: text field - Audio only via TTS, NEVER displayed on screen

issues.title: Renderer prompts not hardened - LLM returns prose instead of code/prompts
issues.description: Remotion renderer sometimes returns prose/garbled text instead of JSON. WAN renderer returns prompts that are too short or vague. Both cause rendering failures.

root_cause.remotion: System prompt not strict enough - LLM returns commentary, markdown, or malformed JSON
root_cause.wan: Prompts too short (<300 words) or contain vague phrases like 'clear diagram', 'appropriate animation'

remotion_prompt_changes: Created remotion_renderer_system_v1.3.txt with ABSOLUTE RULES: code-only, no prose, no markdown, no backticks
Added validate_remotion_output() function with JSON parse validation
Added single retry on parse failure
wan_prompt_changes: Created video_renderer_system_v1.3.txt with 300-word minimum and FORBIDDEN PHRASES list
Created video_renderer_user_v1.3.txt with per-beat expansion constraints
Added validate_video_prompts() function with word count check and vague phrase detection
Added single retry on validation failure

validation_rules.remotion: Must parse as valid JSON with remotion_scene_spec key
validation_rules.wan: Each prompt ≥300 words, no vague phrases from forbidden list

issues.title: TTS TypeError: expected string got dict for v1.3 narration
issues.description: generate_section_audio() passed narration dict (v1.3 format) directly to latex_to_speech() which expects a string
issues.root_cause: TTS code not updated for v1.3 narration format change (narration is now a dict with full_text and segments)
issues.fix: Added isinstance check to extract full_text from dict, fallback to combining segment texts

issues.title: Feature: Job resume capability for failed jobs
issues.description: Added ability to resume failed jobs from a specific phase (render or audio) without re-running expensive LLM passes
issues.fix: Added detect_job_phase() and resume_job_from_phase() functions, plus API endpoints /jobs/<id>/resume and /jobs/<id>/phases

issues.title: Avatar not displaying in player
issues.description: Avatar video not showing on any slides. Player looks for avatar_placeholder.mp4 in job folder (e.g., /jobs/38328ac4/) but file only exists in shared /player/assets/ folder.
issues.root_cause: BASE_PATH resolves to job folder, player never falls back to shared assets when avatar file is missing in job folder. presentation.avatar_url metadata is ignored.
issues.proposed_fix: Use shared /player/assets/avatar_placeholder.mp4 path or read presentation.avatar_url metadata. Implement proper fallback chain.

issues.title: Videos not displaying or showing same video repeatedly
issues.description: Content sections show no video or same video repeating. Job 38328ac4 has topic_3.mp4, topic_4.mp4, topic_7.mp4 but other sections get 404s.
issues.root_cause: Player guesses video filenames as topic_<section_id>.mp4 instead of reading actual section.video_path metadata from presentation.json. Pipeline reconciles video paths but player ignores them.
issues.proposed_fix: Read video_path from presentation.sections[].video_path and beat.video_path instead of filename guessing. Use metadata-first approach.

issues.title: Content visual swap happens too fast before video ready
issues.description: Text layer hides immediately on segment change, but video is not ready yet. Creates jarring "too fast" visual swap.
issues.root_cause: applyDirectives() changes layer visibility synchronously on segment change without waiting for video canplay event. display_directives say hide text before visual, but no video-ready gating.
issues.proposed_fix: Wait for video canplay event before applying display_directives that hide text and show visuals. Add async video state management.
issues.resolution_note: Added video-ready gating to LayerController.applyDirectives(). Waits for canplay event (max 2s timeout) before hiding text when transitioning to video display.

issues.title: Memory flashcards not displayed - missing renderer
issues.description: Memory section shows blank/empty instead of flashcards with question/answer flip. Schema provides visual_beats[] with flashcard data but player ignores it.
issues.root_cause: Player has no renderer for flashcard beat type. Memory section routes through text/image logic instead of flashcard-specific renderer. No component checks beat.visual_beat_type === "flashcard".
issues.proposed_fix: Implement dedicated flashcard renderer that iterates visual_beats[], displays question side, flips to answer side with animation. Use flashcard data structure from schema.

issues.title: Recap videos not loading - wrong filename pattern
issues.description: Recap section shows no videos despite having video_path data in presentation.json. Recap scenes should play sequentially.
issues.root_cause: detectVideosForSlide() only searches topic_<id> naming pattern. Recap videos use recap_<id>_scene_<n>.mp4 pattern which is ignored. section.video_path metadata exists but not read.
issues.proposed_fix: Use section.video_path / beat.video_path metadata for recap videos. Implement scene playlist for recap sections.

issues.title: Director generates visual_layer=hide for all content segments
issues.description: Director LLM sets visual_layer=hide in display_directives for all narration segments, causing videos to never display even when has_content_video=true
issues.impact: Video content is not visible to users despite being loaded correctly
issues.root_cause: Director prompt did not explicitly instruct when visual_layer must be shown
issues.solution: Added MANDATORY VISUAL ACTIVATION RULE to director_system_v1.3.txt requiring at least one segment with visual_layer=show/replace when visual_beats exist. Added validate_visuals_are_shown() Tier-1 validator in hard_fail_validator.py to enforce this rule.

issues.title: Director assigns Manim to biology content instead of WAN
issues.description: Director assigns renderer=manim to biology/anatomy content (Human Eye chapter sections 3,4,5) which should use wan_video for photorealistic organic content
issues.impact: Biology content gets wrong renderer - Manim is for math/physics, WAN is for organic/cinematic
issues.root_cause: Director renderer decision rules didn't consider subject matter (biology vs math/physics)
issues.solution: Added MANDATORY RENDERER SELECTION RULES (STRICT) to director_system_v1.3.txt with subject-aware rules: Biology=video (Manim forbidden), Math/Physics formulas=Manim, Recap=video. Added validate_renderer_subject_match() Tier-1 validator in hard_fail_validator.py.

issues.title: WAN runner ignores video_prompts and forces visual_compiler validation
issues.description: WAN runner always calls compile_wan_prompt() when visual_beats exist, even when explanation_plan.video_prompts are already provided. This forces visual_compiler validation which fails because v1.3 Director outputs lightweight visual_beats (beat_id, description) without schema fields (scene_setup, objects_and_properties, motion_sequence).
issues.impact: All video sections fail to render with 'Visual beat has no content' error despite having valid pre-compiled video_prompts. Dry run job 022d2c98 sections 3,4 failed.
issues.root_cause: render/wan/wan_runner.py _render_visual_beats() does not check for pre-existing video_prompts before calling visual_compiler
issues.downstream_impact: WAN renderer must accept pre-authored prompts instead of compiling from visual_beats
issues.solution: Added video_prompts parameter to _render_visual_beats(). Updated render_wan_video() to extract video_prompts from explanation_plan and pass to _render_visual_beats(). When video_prompts exist, use them directly (bypassing visual_compiler) instead of compiling from visual_beats.

issues.title: Vague phrase 'etc' missing from llm_client_v12 VAGUE_PHRASES
issues.description: 'etc' is a vague phrase that degrades video prompt quality but was not in the VAGUE_PHRASES list in llm_client_v12.py (already exists in wan_prompt_validator.py).
issues.impact: Video prompts containing 'etc' could pass validation in some code paths
issues.root_cause: Inconsistent vague phrase lists across validator modules
issues.solution: Added 'etc', 'and so on', 'and more' to VAGUE_PHRASES in core/llm_client_v12.py to match wan_prompt_validator.py

issues.title: Player overwrites section-level recap_video_paths when visual_beats lack video_path
issues.description: Player code (line 1341-1348) defaults recap sections to topic_<id>.mp4 and only uses multi-scene paths if visual_beats[0].video_path exists. But presentation.json has correct recap_video_paths at section level that gets ignored.
issues.impact: Recap sections show placeholder video instead of actual 5-scene recap videos. Job 38328ac4 section 7 has recap_7_scene_1-5.mp4 files but player requests topic_7.mp4
issues.root_cause: Player checks visual_beats.video_path instead of section-level recap_video_paths first
issues.downstream_impact: Player must prefer section-level recap_video_paths over default naming
issues.solution: Updated player.js to check section.recap_video_paths FIRST. If present, use those paths directly. Falls back to visual_beats.video_path then topic_<id>.mp4 as last resort.

issues.title: Blank video panel between beat/recap video transitions
issues.description: When switching between beat videos or recap scene videos, there's a visible blank panel while the new video loads. This creates a jarring experience instead of smooth continuous playback.
issues.root_cause: Direct video.src swap causes loading gap - no preloading of next video
issues.solution: Implement video double-buffering: preload next video in hidden element, swap when ready
issues.resolution_note: Fixed by VideoBufferManager class in player.js which preloads and swaps videos smoothly

issues.title: Job folders have stale player.js copies that don't receive bug fixes
issues.description: Each job folder gets a copy of player.js at creation time. Bug fixes to player.js don't propagate to existing jobs.
issues.root_cause: setup_job_folder() copies player.js to job folder; index.html references local copy
issues.solution: Change index.html template to reference /player/player.js instead of local copy
issues.resolution_note: Already fixed - job folder index.html references /player/player.js (main location), stale copies in job folders are not used

issues.title: Uploaded file content not verified - job ran with wrong content
issues.description: User uploaded Sample_subjects.md with new content (Calculus/Biology) but job generated Human Eye content. No verification of uploaded content before processing.
issues.root_cause: Possible browser file caching or sync issue; no content preview shown to user
issues.solution: Add content preview in submit response showing first 200 chars of uploaded file

issues.title: Video sections fail with 'Visual beat has no content' despite pre-compiled video_prompts
issues.impact: All video sections (renderer=video/wan) fail to render. Sections 3 and 9 in job 9e2d677f failed despite having valid video_prompts from LLM.

root_cause.summary: Key mismatch between renderer_executor.py and wan_runner.py
details: renderer_executor.py line 108 stores prompts as 'video_prompts_list' in explanation_plan
wan_runner.py line 41 looks for 'video_prompts' key in explanation_plan (not video_prompts_list)
Because key doesn't match, wan_runner falls through to visual_beats path
visual_beats array is empty or contains placeholder objects without content
visual_compiler.validate_visual_beat_structure() raises 'Visual beat has no content' error
data_flow: Falls back to visual_beats → empty → FAIL

fix.verification: Run dry run and verify video sections complete without 'Visual beat has no content' error

issues.notes: ISS-067 added pre-compiled video_prompts support but used wrong key name during wiring
issues.resolution_note: Fixed key mismatch in renderer_executor.py line 108: changed video_prompts_list to video_prompts

issues.title: Duration/timing sync - duration_seconds not validated against actual TTS audio length
issues.impact: Audio/visual drift during playback. LLM-generated duration_seconds values don't match actual TTS audio durations.

details: Director LLM generates duration_seconds per narration segment (often constant 6-8 seconds)
TTS (Narakeet) generates audio with actual word-based duration
No pipeline step reconciles duration_seconds with actual audio length
Player schedules segment transitions using LLM durations, not actual audio
Result: display_directives fire at wrong times, causing audio/visual desync

fix_required: Add post-TTS sync pass that updates duration_seconds based on actual audio length
Regenerate timed_segments after audio generation
Ensure display_directives align with actual segment durations

issues.title: Subject-aware renderer validation not invoked in pipeline
issues.impact: Biology content could incorrectly be routed to manim renderer instead of video/WAN. No subject gating enforced.

root_cause.summary: validate_renderer_subject_match() exists but is never called
details: hard_fail_validator.py has validate_renderer_subject_match() function
This function validates biology→video, math→manim, etc.
pipeline_v12.py skips semantic validations when JSON schema passes
Subject-aware renderer enforcement is bypassed entirely

fix_required: Wire validate_renderer_subject_match() into pipeline_v12.py
Call after Director output, before renderer dispatch
Hard fail or auto-correct renderer for biology/chemistry content

issues.title: WAN prompt word count validation not enforced - prompts often <50 words
issues.impact: Video prompts too short/vague for quality WAN video generation. Job artifacts show <50 word prompts when spec requires 300+.

root_cause.summary: No aggregated word count validation before WAN API call
details: v1.3 spec requires 300+ words per WAN beat prompt
Director LLM sometimes generates short/vague video_prompts
wan_prompt_validator.py exists but only logs warnings, doesn't block
No hard fail when prompts are below minimum word count
Result: Low-quality or failed video generation from kie.ai

fix_required: Add hard fail validation for video prompts < MIN_WAN_PROMPT_WORDS (300)
Block WAN API calls for under-specified prompts
Add retry logic to request Director to expand video_prompts

issues.title: Two-channel separation failing - visual_content not extracted, narration.text displayed instead
issues.impact: Player displays narration.text (meant for TTS only) on screen instead of proper visual_content (bullet_points, formulas).

root_cause.summary: Director not extracting displayable content into visual_content field
details: v1.3 spec: narration.segments[].text = TTS audio ONLY (never displayed)
v1.3 spec: visual_content = screen display (bullet_points, formula, labels)
Director sometimes omits visual_content or leaves it empty
Player falls back to showing narration text when visual_content missing
Violates two-channel separation principle

fix_required: Add hard fail validation: content sections MUST have visual_content with bullet_points
Update Director prompt to emphasize visual_content extraction from source
Player should show error placeholder (not narration text) when visual_content missing for v1.3+
issues.resolution_note: Added hard fail check 'missing_visual_content' in validate_v13_section_rules(). Validates that content/example/summary sections with text_layer=show have visual_content (bullet_points, formula, or labels). Director prompt already emphasizes visual_content. Player already shows error placeholder for v1.3+.

issues.title: Dry run does not validate rendered asset paths - placeholders accepted as success
issues.impact: Dry run completes 'successfully' but presentation.json references non-existent video files. Player fails to load videos.

root_cause.summary: Dry run skips video API but also skips asset verification
details: Dry run mode skips actual manim/WAN video generation (correct)
But dry run should still verify: 1) prompts are complete, 2) output paths are set, 3) all required assets would be generated
Currently dry run writes 'dry_run.txt' placeholders
No validation that all referenced video_path values point to real/expected files
Player tries to load videos from presentation.json paths that don't exist

fix_required: Dry run should validate all render specs are complete (prompts, scene specs)
Dry run should write expected video paths to manifest for verification
Add asset manifest validation: all referenced paths exist or are expected
Player should handle missing videos gracefully with clear error message

issues.title: Player has no validation - silently fails when display_directives or visual_content missing
issues.impact: Player silently ignores missing data. Visuals don't show, segments don't highlight, no error shown to user.

root_cause.summary: Player is purely reactive with no defensive validation
details: LayerController.applyDirectives() silently returns if display_directives missing
loadSlide() doesn't validate required fields exist before proceeding
checkExistingPresentation() has try-catch but logs generic message
No visual feedback to user when content fails to render
User sees blank sections with no explanation

fix_required: Add validateSlideData() function to check required fields
Show error overlay when critical fields missing (display_directives, visual_content for v1.3+)
Log detailed validation errors to console for debugging
Add spec_version guard: v1.3+ requires stricter validation

issues.title: Director LLM Fails v1.3 Structural Validation Consistently
issues.description: Director (Gemini 2.5 Pro) fails to follow v1.3 structural requirements after multiple retries. Common failures include: (1) Missing memory/recap sections, (2) text_layer=show + visual_layer=show mutual exclusion violations, (3) Memory section not having exactly 5 flashcards, (4) Recap section not having exactly 5 scenes, (5) Recap avatar_layer not set to 'hide'
observations: Biology job 4efd2a9e failed with structural errors after 2 retries
Multi-subject job 6aca7933 failed with semantic errors (formula not visualized)
Previous Special Relativity job d596d9ad also showed 65 warnings
Director prompt has correct rules but LLM doesn't follow them consistently
Retry prompts may not be effective at correcting specific errors
root_cause_hypothesis: Prompt is too long (~400 lines) - LLM may lose focus on specific rules
Retry prompt doesn't explicitly list the specific errors to fix
No examples of WRONG output to avoid
LLM may be truncating output (JSON parse errors)
proposed_solutions: Add explicit 'DO NOT' examples showing wrong patterns
Pass specific validation errors to retry prompt
Consider structured output mode / JSON schema enforcement
Add pre-flight checklist at end of prompt
Split into smaller sub-prompts for each section type

issues.title: Recap Director semantic validation crashes when LLM returns video_prompt as dict
issues.description: Job dc0c1a05 failed with AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'split' in _validate_semantics(). LLM returned video_prompt as dict object instead of string.
issues.error: AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'split' at line 288 in recap_director.py
issues.root_cause: No type checking on video_prompt before calling .split()
issues.fix: Added isinstance checks to handle dict case, extract text/prompt field or stringify

issues.title: Recap Director system prompt had v1.3 format conflicting with v1.4 user prompt
issues.description: System prompt said 'EXACTLY 2 sections: memory and recap' (v1.3) while user prompt said '6 sections with recap_scene_1-5' (v1.4). LLM followed system prompt and returned invalid 'recap' section_type.
issues.error: Structural errors: Invalid section_type 'recap' - allowed: memory, recap_scene_1-5
issues.root_cause: User prompt was updated to v1.4 split architecture but system prompt was not updated
issues.fix: Rewrote recap_director_system_v1.4.txt to match v1.4 architecture with 6 sections
issues.testing_gap: Initial curl test happened to get compliant LLM output - did not verify prompt consistency or test multiple runs

issues.title: V1.4 pipeline missing video rendering step - only generates presentation.json
issues.description: process_markdown_job() only called process_markdown_to_presentation_v14() which generates presentation.json, but did NOT call render_all_topics() to generate WAN videos.
issues.root_cause: Incomplete v1.4 pipeline implementation - rendering step was not wired up
issues.fix: Added render_all_topics() call after presentation validation in process_markdown_job(), with proper status updates and error handling
issues.testing_gap: Did not verify end-to-end output files - only checked presentation.json generation

issues.title: Content section video_prompts not wired to WAN renderer
issues.description: WAN renderer looked for video_prompts in explanation_plan (line 44), but llm_client_v12.py stores them directly on section['video_prompts'] (line 794). LLM was working perfectly - only wiring was wrong.
issues.error: Content sections with valid video_prompts were not rendering because WAN runner couldn't find them
issues.root_cause: Field location mismatch: llm_client stores at section.video_prompts, wan_runner reads from section.explanation_plan.video_prompts
issues.fix: Updated wan_runner.py line 44 to check topic.get('video_prompts', []) first, then fall back to explanation_plan
issues.lesson: LLM layer is working - issues are in renderer wiring. Trace data flow from LLM output through merge step to renderer input.

issues.title: Recap scenes wan_prompt field name mismatch
issues.description: Merge step created recap_scenes with 'video_prompt' field, but WAN runner expected 'wan_prompt' field. Caused 'Beat 0: Prompt has 0 words' error.
issues.error: WAN renderer showed 0 word prompts for recap scenes despite presentation.json having valid prompts
issues.root_cause: Field name mismatch: merge_step used 'video_prompt', wan_runner.py _render_recap_scenes() reads 'wan_prompt'
issues.fix: Updated merge_step.py to include both wan_prompt and video_prompt fields in recap_scenes
issues.lesson: When integrating components, verify exact field names expected by downstream consumers. Add both field names for compatibility.

issues.title: Audio path not set in presentation.json sections
issues.description: sync_timing_with_audio() was not setting audio_path and audio_duration on sections, so player couldn't find audio files.
issues.root_cause: TTS duration sync function only updated timing but didn't store audio file paths
issues.fix: Updated sync_timing_with_audio() in generate_audio.py to set audio_path and audio_duration on each section

issues.title: Manim generated code may have syntax/runtime errors
issues.description: LLM-generated Manim code may contain Python syntax errors or use unsupported Manim APIs, causing subprocess crashes during rendering.
issues.impact: Math/physics sections fail to render, falling back to placeholder or failing hard
issues.mitigation: Current code logs stderr from Manim subprocess. May need: 1) Code validation before exec, 2) Better error messages, 3) Safe code template constraints
issues.next_steps: Monitor actual Manim failures in production. Collect error samples to identify common LLM code generation mistakes.

issues.title: Player video-ready class not cleared on mid-slide video switch
issues.description: When VideoBufferManager.switchTo() loaded a new video mid-slide (e.g., recap scene transitions), the 'video-ready' class was never cleared. LayerController.isVideoReady() returned true immediately, hiding text before new video was actually ready.
issues.error: Text layer hides too early during recap scene transitions, causing blank screen while video buffers
issues.root_cause: switchTo() never cleared video-ready class, so LayerController assumed new video was ready immediately
issues.fix: Updated switchTo() to: 1) Clear video-ready class immediately, 2) Add canplay listener to re-add class when new video is ready

issues.title: Recap video preload happens too late - first transition stutters
issues.description: preloadNext() was called AFTER switchTo() during recap scene transitions, so the first recap transition always hit the 150ms fallback path instead of instant switch.
issues.error: First recap scene transition has potential stutter/gap because second video not preloaded in time
issues.root_cause: Preload triggered during switch instead of at slide load start
issues.fix: Added preload of second recap video at slide start (before any transitions needed)

issues.title: Recap Director prompt specifies 100+ words but WAN requires 300+ words
issues.description: Recap Director system prompt specified 100+ words for video_prompt, but WAN runner validates for 300+ words minimum. This mismatch caused all recap video rendering to fail with 'minimum 300 required' error.
issues.error: WAN Recap validation failed: Beat 0: Prompt has 135 words, minimum 300 required
issues.root_cause: Mismatch between Recap Director prompt (100+ words) and WAN runner validation (300+ words) and v1.4 spec (300+ words)
issues.fix: Updated recap_director_system_v1.4.txt to require 300+ words for video_prompt, emphasized this in multiple places
issues.lesson: Always verify prompt requirements match downstream validator requirements

issues.title: Recap Director FORBIDDEN phrases list incomplete - missing 'etc'
issues.description: Recap Director prompt FORBIDDEN section only had generic examples but didn't list the exact phrases the validator checks for ('etc', 'and so on', 'various', etc). LLM generated 'etc' which was rejected by validator.
issues.error: Video renderer: Beat 3: Contains vague phrase 'etc'. Retrying (1/1)... then failed
issues.root_cause: FORBIDDEN section in prompt didn't explicitly list all phrases that validator rejects
issues.fix: Updated FORBIDDEN section to list exact phrases that cause rejection, matching wan_prompt_validator.py
issues.lesson: Prompt FORBIDDEN lists must exactly match validator phrase detection lists

issues.title: recap_video_paths never set - 5 recap videos generated but not wired to player
issues.description: WAN renderer generates 5 recap videos (recap_{topic_id}_scene_{1..5}.mp4) but _render_recap_scenes only returned first path. recap_video_paths was never populated on sections, so player only saw first video or no videos.
issues.error: Player shows 'No video available' for recap scenes 2-5, or only first recap video plays
issues.root_cause: Critical wiring gap: _render_recap_scenes returned video_paths[0] instead of all 5 paths. No code path set recap_video_paths on sections.
issues.fix: 1) _render_recap_scenes returns dict with first_path and all_paths, 2) render_wan_video stores all_paths on topic._recap_video_paths, 3) execute_renderer captures recap_video_paths to result, 4) _reconcile_video_paths sets recap_video_paths on recap sections
issues.lesson: Verify complete data flow from renderer to player for multi-item outputs

issues.title: Manim beat_videos never set - multi-beat videos detected by filesystem probe not metadata
issues.description: Manim render_manim_video returns list of beat video paths for multi-beat sections, but execute_renderer stored the list as result['video_path']. _reconcile_video_paths assumed string, only extracted first filename. Player fell back to HTTP HEAD filesystem detection.
issues.error: Player uses fragile filesystem probing for beat videos instead of presentation.json metadata
issues.root_cause: Same wiring gap as ISS-092 - multi-item outputs from renderer not properly surfaced to presentation.json
issues.fix: 1) execute_renderer detects list return and stores as beat_videos, 2) _reconcile_video_paths handles beat_videos arrays, 3) Player loader uses section.beat_videos from metadata-first before filesystem fallback
issues.lesson: All renderers returning multiple outputs need explicit wiring to presentation.json, not filesystem detection

issues.title: Video Renderer prompt/WAN validation word count mismatch
issues.description: Video Renderer prompt instructed 100-150 words per prompt, but WAN runner validation requires 300+ words. This caused systematic WAN prompt rejections.
issues.error: WAN prompt validation failed: Beat X: Prompt has Y words, minimum 300 required
issues.root_cause: Prompt requirement (100-150) did not match validation threshold (300+)
issues.fix: Updated video_renderer_system_v1.3.txt and video_renderer_user_v1.3.txt to require 300+ words with guidance on how to reach that count
issues.lesson: Prompt requirements must exactly match validation thresholds

issues.title: Recap Director generating 300+ word video_prompts directly (cognitive overload)
issues.description: Recap Director prompt asked for 300+ word video_prompts directly, putting too much cognitive load on the Director LLM and bypassing the Video Renderer LLM expansion step.
issues.error: Recap scenes with 235 words rejected (under 300 threshold) or LLM compliance failures
issues.root_cause: v1.4 Recap Director bypassed Video Renderer LLM, unlike v1.3 content sections which use short visual_beats expanded by Video Renderer
issues.fix: Changed Recap Director to output short visual_beats (50-80 words), Video Renderer LLM now expands them to 300+. Updated merge_step to handle visual_beats format.
issues.lesson: Director LLMs should output short descriptions; Renderer LLMs expand to full prompts

issues.title: Quiz section incorrectly using WAN renderer
issues.description: Quiz sections were being passed to WAN renderer, which failed because quiz has no visual_beats or video_prompts.
issues.error: Section X (quiz): No WAN prompt available
issues.root_cause: Quiz not in TEXT_ONLY_SECTION_TYPES, so renderer policy didn't skip it
issues.fix: Added 'quiz' to TEXT_ONLY_SECTION_TYPES in renderer_executor.py
issues.lesson: Text-only sections must be explicitly listed to skip video rendering

issues.title: Quiz section always generated even when not in source markdown
issues.description: Content Director always fabricates a quiz section regardless of whether quiz/exercise content exists in the source markdown. Quiz should be CONDITIONAL - only generated if the source .md contains quiz/exercise content.
issues.error: Fabricated quiz content displayed when original document had no quiz
issues.root_cause: 1) Smart Chunker doesn't flag quiz presence, 2) Content Director prompt hard-requires quiz, 3) No signaling from Chunker to Director about quiz presence
issues.proposed_fix: 1) Smart Chunker adds has_quiz flag, 2) Content Director conditionally generates quiz only if flagged, 3) Validation treats quiz as optional

issues.title: Content Director only creates 2 sections from 5 Smart Chunker topics (60% content loss)
issues.description: Smart Chunker correctly identifies 5 topics from source markdown, but Content Director only creates 2 content sections. 3 topics (Mathematics, Geometry, Chemistry) are completely lost.
issues.error: Job 0a6fb562: Source has 5 topics, presentation.json only has 2 content sections
issues.root_cause: V1.4 Content Director prompt was missing critical V1.3 instructions: 1) 'content (multiple)' instruction, 2) 'one section per topic' requirement, 3) 'extract from source document' rule
issues.fix: Rewrote content_director_system_v1.4.txt with explicit TOPIC-TO-SECTION MAPPING rule: one content section per Chunker topic. Added source document extraction and LaTeX preservation rules.
issues.lesson: When splitting a prompt (v1.3 Director → v1.4 Content+Recap), all critical instructions must be carefully distributed to the right prompt

issues.title: LaTeX formulas from source markdown not preserved in presentation
issues.description: Source markdown contains 6+ LaTeX formulas (integrals, sector area, equilibrium constant, etc.) but only 1 formula appears in final presentation. Formulas must be passed through to visual_content.formula.
issues.error: Missing formulas: integral F(b)-F(a), sector area, cylinder volume, period formula, equilibrium Kc
issues.root_cause: V1.4 Content Director prompt had no LaTeX preservation instructions
issues.fix: Added LATEX FORMULA PRESERVATION section to content_director_system_v1.4.txt with explicit rules to preserve formulas exactly as written in source
issues.lesson: Content extraction rules must explicitly cover formula/LaTeX passthrough

metadata.testing_lesson: Prompt FORBIDDEN lists must exactly match validator detection patterns
metadata.v14_video_retries: Video renderer now has 3 total attempts (max_retries=2) for 300+ word compliance
